name: Command error triage: one structured next-step receipt
description: Get rule-based triage for a failed build, deployment, or shell command when the next step is unclear. Submit a redacted command and error; receive root_cause, next_command, retry_plan, risk_note, prevention_note, and generated_at as JSON. Suggestions only: no code execution, repository inspection, or guaranteed repair. Read the free preview before authorizing a paid request.
